scope: Cat grounding and investor-room actions, plus the fleet-review repair of provider routing, completion readiness, permission decisions and recovery. Domain permission and action ownership rules remain local to OrangeCat. Temporary-chat privacy is propagated through the existing tool loop; product memory-write policy stays local. Article writing reuses the existing Markdown editor and writing API backed by the platform model service; one draft-scoped controller owns generation and revision. Article generation and editing consume the verified WritingKit release; the bootstrap runtime copy is retired.

chat.notes: Retain the shared chat surface and transport contracts. Investor-room routes and per-user project context are product domain policy.

deck.notes: Chat uses the same generator and ownership-checked deck persistence as the room UI. Product records remain canonical in Loki; the OrangeCat profile and room render them without storing copies.

grounding.notes: Reuse packaged verification. The application supplies its verified navigation evidence and protects links to fetched project rooms during repair.

writing.notes: WritingKit owns operation/revision safety. OrangeCat owns fields, selection, Undo, device/account draft storage, writing context and publishing. ai-kit and the existing article APIs still own model/HTTP execution.

messenger.notes: Direct messages are the packaged Messenger: list, thread, box, files and the agent mark are the package's. OrangeCat owns the transport (its routes and realtime channels), attachment storage (a private bucket behind signed URLs), the Cat as the agent, sending as a group, and the @mention menu.

account-menu.notes: The header's account menu is the package's: layout, keyboard handling, sign-out and switch-account failure states. OrangeCat supplies the person, the places, the identities (ADR-0014) and what a tap does. Accounts themselves stay on Supabase auth; ./auth is not adopted.
